detect_job_change.description: Check whether someone still works at the company you have on file. Datagma looks up their current employer and answers with a plain 'changed jobs' true or false, plus where they are now. Use this to keep a CRM clean, or to spot a champion who has moved somewhere worth following them to. Coverage is strongest in France, Spain, Italy and Germany.

find_work_email.description: Find and verify someone's work email address from their name and their company. Datagma checks the mailbox before answering, so a returned address is confirmed rather than guessed, except on a domain that accepts all mail, where it returns its best guess and flags it (and does not charge for it). Use this to complete a lead list before a campaign.

description: Enrich B2B leads and accounts with Datagma. Turn a LinkedIn URL, an email or a name and a company into a full contact record (job title, employer, location, verified work email and mobile number), look a company up by domain, LinkedIn page, name or French SIREN for its headcount, industry, funding and registry details, check whether a contact has changed jobs, find who a phone number belongs to, and read the credit balance before a batch.
